example.title: Publish and receive a digest record
description: Each tab names a file relative to the project root. Java `17` and Maven are required. `mvn spring-boot:run` starts this example after its external requirements are configured.
A `NewTopic` bean describes the topic that Boot’s Kafka administrator requests at startup.
Boot calls each `ApplicationRunner` bean after the application context initializes.
The example runner supplies the publication operation.
The Spring Boot 3.5 project uses `spring-kafka` and `spring-boot-starter-web`.
The web starter supplies the managed JSON mapper.
This local demonstration requires a broker reachable through `KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS` and permission to create `weekly-sentiments`.
One partition and one replica suit a one-broker demonstration only.
The application runner publishes the fixed demonstration event once per application startup.
It does not run for every request.
The listener validates and logs receipt.
It deliberately performs no email submission.
A production mail processor must first load the authorized recipient and handle repeated event IDs.
